Definition
[injectivity-radius condition at almost maximum points] Source: cao-zhu 1. Definition 4.3.2\group Cao–Zhu Limiting Singularity Models We say that the solution satisfies injectivity radius condition\index{injectivity radius!condition} if for any sequence of (almost) maximum points $\{ (x_k,t_k)\} $, there exists a constant $c_2>0$ independent of $k$ such that \[ \inj (M,x_k,g_{ij}(t_k))\geq \frac{c_2}{\sqrt{K_{\max }(t_k)}} \quad \text{for all }\; k. \]
